notes: Basil-approved index (18 Nov 2026). Only manifest status=ready recipes are included. main = defining ingredients; all = every canonical id after dedupe. hidden/picker=false chips stay matchable but are omitted from the picker.

groups.label: Salt, pepper, and water
groups.rationale: Almost every savory recipe in this set lists salt, pepper, and/or water. Counting them as missing would make nearly every dish look incomplete. SuperCook asks you to add oils and spices yourself (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.supercook.app); for a 37-recipe site, assuming these three is the better default. The user can turn the assumption off.

groups.label: Cooking oils (olive and neutral)
groups.rationale: A short-cut so a missing tablespoon of oil does not bury a dinner match. Sesame oil, ghee, and niter kibbeh stay off this list because they are flavor-specific. Peanut oil is grouped with neutral oils for matching, but an exclude-peanut filter should still hide recipes that require it with no alternative.
